paite: Huchi in Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah sawltak mite asawl a, sidar singte, suangsek mite, khutsiam mite, inn lamsak ding in.
heading: Jerusalem A David Nasepte / (2 Sam 5.11-16)

paite: David in Israel tung ah TOUPA'N amah kumpipa in akoihkipta chih athei a, agam lah, ami Israelte, sangpi a tawisang in a-omta hi.
David in Jerusalem ah zite tamsem api a: huchi in David in tapate leh tanute tamsem asuangta hi.
Hiaite Jerusalem a aneih tate minte ahi; Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon;
Philistia mite'n Israel tengteng tung ah kumpipa a David thaunilh ahi chih azak un, David zong ding in Philistia mite tengteng akuantou ua: David in huai azak in, amaute dou ding in akuankheta hi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna / (2 Sam 5.17-25)

paite: Philistia mite ahong ua, Rephaim Phaizang atuam uhi.
Huchi in David in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite dou ding in ka kuantou diam? Amau ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Kuantou in; na khut a amaute hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.

Huchi in Baal-perazim ah ahong tou ua, David in amau athat a; huchi in David in, "Pathian in tui khah bang in ka khut in ka melmate ahihsia," achi a. Huaiziak in huai mun min ding in Baal-perazim asa hi.
Huai ah apathiante uh anusia ua; David in thupiak apia a, mei in ahal uhi.
Huchih nung in Philistiate'n phaizang atuam nawn lai uhi.
David in Pathian thu adong nawn a; Pathian in akiang ah, "Amau delh ding in na kuantou kei ding: amau kihei mangsan inla, singtheimi singte zawntak ah amau sual in,” achi hi.
"Singthei mi singte dawn a taiging na zak chiang in; huai chiang in kidou ding in na kuankhe ding hi: Philistia mihonte that ding in na ma ah Pathian akuankheta chihna ahi ding hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Pathian in amah thu apiak bang in David in ahih a: Gibeon a kipan Gezer pha in Philistia mihonpi athatta uhi.
Huan gam tengteng ah David min athangkheta a; huchi in TOUPA'N nam tengteng tung ah amah launa atungsakta hi.
